title: Citrus Herb Bruschetta
description: A simple and flavorful appetizer or side dish featuring toasted bread topped with a mixture of citrus zest, herbs, and wine-soaked tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Citrus Zest
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup mixed citrus zest (orange, lemon, lime)

ingredients.name: Fresh Herbs
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley and basil

instructions: Slice the baguette into 1/2-inch thick rounds and toast until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the citrus zest, chopped herbs, and olive oil.
Brush the toasted bread with the citrus-herb mixture.
Top each bread round with a spoonful of bruschetta and drizzle with wine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
